notes.drive.brake: the plug brake (bluewave/motor.PlugBrake), OFF (active 0): with 1, a command 0.3 m/s or more below the speed estimate, the same way, reverses the duty (<= 0.3, <= 250 ms, >= 50 ms at duty 0 before each DIR flip) until the speed is the target; a stop, E-STOP, the dead-man stay the PWM-low brake.  ax_max 4.472 = min(mu g, nose-over g (wheelbase - x_cg) / h_cg 6.71) / 1.5; tau 0.52 = the mat's brake tau (from 0.25 m/s only).  The reverse duty's deceleration is [EST] (the plant law with that tau).  [NEXT MAT] bw test coast speeds=[0.5,0.8,1.2] (does the PWM-low tau hold at speed?), then the same speeds with drive.brake.active 1 and a brake-to-v leg (1.2 -> 0.4 m/s; tests.coast has none yet): the front wall's lidar range gives the deceleration against the law's
